decisions.statement: Markup is flattened away before anything is cut.
A fenced code block is spoken as a note that code was left out.
A sentence is cut at a stop followed by space.
Sentences are packed together up to the budget rather than sent one sentence at a time.
A word longer than the budget is broken inside itself.
The number of pieces is capped.
A piece past the cap is dropped.
A leading bracketed marker is taken off each paragraph before the paragraph is spoken.
Nothing here reaches a voice model.

definition: written text flattened and cut into pieces short enough for a voice to render at once
